user.title: Connect to Famly
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use for the Famly parent app. They are stored in Home Assistant and used to sign in again when the session expires.

data_description.region: Use famly.de if you sign in at app.famly.de, otherwise famly.co.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Famly again
reauth_confirm.description: Famly rejected the stored login for {email}. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: Famly rejected the email or password.
error.auth_challenge: Famly asked for an extra sign-in step (two-factor or choosing an account). This integration does not support that yet.
error.no_children: This Famly login is not linked to any children.

abort.already_configured: This Famly login is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That password belongs to a different Famly account.

init.title: Photo sync to Immich
init.description: Every hour, new photos from the nursery news feed are downloaded, dated, uploaded to Immich and deleted from Home Assistant straight away. Leave Immich empty to turn this off.

data_description.immich_entry_id: An Immich integration already set up in Home Assistant.
data_description.immich_album_id: Optional. Paste the album's URL or ID from the Immich web app.
data_description.backfill_since: Optional one-off import of older photos, paced at up to 60 an hour. Leave empty to only sync photos posted from now on.

error.immich_required: Choose an Immich server to use the album or import options.
